name: 720M
tagline: Laughter and grief, in rhythm and rhyme.
bio: 720M explores themes of laughter and grief in rhythm and rhyme. An avid freestyle nut, 720M taps into the eternal wave and shares what he finds on record. He writes poetry as a form of therapy and lives in sunny San Diego where he makes art, surfs, and walks his furry friend Swami.
madeWith: Made with friends: "FANNYPACK" and "Levis" with Flavorful Croissants, "Ambient Night" with James Eagle.
cardBlurb: 720M explores themes of laughter and grief in rhythm and rhyme.

name: Dan Perales
bio: Dan Perales raps on the Hip-Hop side of the crew. Start with "Cayo" (feat. Ant Del$ol), "Gentéfication", and "Bajo La Pluma".
cardBlurb: Dan Perales raps on the Hip-Hop side of the crew. Start with "Cayo" (feat. Ant Del$ol), "Gentéfication", and "Bajo La Pluma".

name: Andrew Bigs
tagline: Raw social commentary with a light-hearted bounce.
bio: Born and raised on San Jose's East Side, Andrew Bigs pairs raw social commentary with a light-hearted bounce. Start with "Feel Good Bigs" and "Hold Up".
cardBlurb: Born and raised on San Jose's East Side, Andrew Bigs pairs raw social commentary with a light-hearted bounce. Start with "Feel Good Bigs" and "Hold Up".

name: Not Däf
tagline: A new DJ project from the workshop. The triangle crew is in charge of the visuals.
bio: Not Däf is a new DJ project from the Flavorful Music workshop: EDM sets with a producer's ear. Sets, mixes and dates are on the way.
The colourful triangle-headed crew is Not Däf's visual signature. They dance through the Grey Palace and Effortless System videos, from a sunset beach to a neon club and a comic-book city.
Booking club nights, private events and livestreams now.
bookingNote: Club nights, private events, livestreams, guest mixes.

name: Flavorful Croissants
bio: Flavorful Croissants is the producer at the centre of Flavorful Music: beat tapes, hip-hop, EDM sketches and songs made with friends out of a San Diego workshop.

The catalogue runs from the 2019 album Introduction to Not Being a Jackass and the DJ Premier-tipped beat tape Feelings that Collected Dust Vol. I to solo techno sketches and a long run of collaborations with 720M, including the single getdownix.
Singer, rapper, songwriter, producer and audio-engineering student, drawn to foley, storytelling and psychoacoustics. Make art with friends till I die.

cardBlurb: Beats for DJs and rappers, including "FANNYPACK" and "Levis" with 720M. Sample packs are on the way.
